notes: Dated Jan 1 pack. Concept 6's morning-after figure and the finished party portrait are the costume and identity references; Basic Mari supplies only framing, scale, baseline, and pixel style. Each story was generated as its own four-beat transparent strip, then normalized into four 128 x 192 cells.

prompts.prompt: Match the right figure from concept 6 as the same Mari the next morning: messy orange-blonde bed hair, glasses askew, dark under-eye rings, pale slightly greenish face, squinting, the same rumpled navy star sweater, grey jeans and sneakers, crushed sideways blue party hat, holding a large glass of water with one hand on her head. Crisp Basic-Mari-family pixel art, full body, transparent background.

Four-beat transparent pixel-art strips, one action per strip: press the cold water glass to her forehead, wince and get a faint idea; dig through couch cushions, find her phone, squint at the bright screen and dim it; line up aspirin, water and dry toast and nod slowly; scroll last night's photos and delete them in horror. Exact concept-6 morning-after outfit and identity throughout.

Four-beat transparent pixel-art strips, one action per strip: try to remember last night, show a fuzzy party-hat thought bubble with a question mark, then groan; find an embarrassing party photo, cringe and hide behind the phone; lie on a couch with an ice pack, twitch one foot and half-open one eye; weakly offer water toward the viewer with a pleading face. Exact concept-6 morning-after outfit and identity throughout.

Four-beat transparent pixel-art strips, one action per strip: drop a fizzing tablet into water, watch it foam, drink and give a weak thumbs-up; brace to stand, wobble, sit back down and try again; fall face-first into a pillow and sleep with one tiny z; sway with water, slow-blink, touch forehead and sip. Exact concept-6 morning-after outfit and identity throughout.

Hold water and squint; heavy blink; limp shrug with ice pack; wince at light; dragged limp like a sack while holding the glass; six crushed-hat bed-hair head angles: neutral, down, down-left, down-right, peering and relieved. Transparent background, Basic Mari framing only.

Preserve outfit and identity exactly.
